name: AnimatedAlign
description: A widget that automatically transitions its child's position over a given duration whenever the alignment changes. Useful for smooth animations when changing alignment.

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: The alignment of the child within the parent. Changes to this value are animated.
properties.possible_values: Alignment.topLeft, Alignment.topCenter, Alignment.topRight, Alignment.centerLeft, Alignment.center, Alignment.centerRight, Alignment.bottomLeft, Alignment.bottomCenter, Alignment.bottomRight, Alignment(x, y)

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time the animation should last when alignment changes.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when changing alignment.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeIn, Curves.easeOut

properties.name: widthFactor
properties.description: If non-null, sets the width of the AnimatedAlign to this factor times the child's width.

properties.name: heightFactor
properties.description: If non-null, sets the height of the AnimatedAlign to this factor times the child's height.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree to animate.
